title: Research venues, journals, standards bodies and language proposal processes
description: Where programming-language research is published (SIGPLAN conferences and other venues, journals, preprint servers) and where languages are standardized: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 22 working groups and their document logs, Ecma, W3C, WHATWG, IETF/RFC Editor, OASIS, Khronos, OMG, IEEE, ITU-T, Unicode, The Open Group, plus the proposal indexes of individual languages (JEP, PEP, Rust RFCs, TC39, Swift Evolution, SRFI, WG21 papers, ...). Venue and body pages are level 3 indexes; proposal/document indexes are level 1 proposal-index.
